title: Mastra AgentController per client for the chat kit
description: createLocusController: one controller per client, client storage, Locus tools bound to a server-side session provider, modes (ask/act), permissions mapped to Locus approval rules. Engine thread adds its build mode and workspace tools on top.

title: Mount the agent controller as the agent API in apps/web
description: Mastra agent-controller HTTP routes under /api/agent, resourceId and client derived from the signed-in member (staff restrictions first), never from the request. Tested with mocks.

title: Per-client conversation memory and approvals that survive a request
description: Mastra Memory + LibSQLStore over the client's own Turso DB; resource from session; GHL tool results stubbed before saving; pendingApprovals/decideApproval across requests. PR #44.

title: Screen GHL data for planted instructions; shared GHL rate budget per client
description: UntrustedContentProcessor (processToolResult) withholds instruction-like strings and taints the run so every write needs approval. Per-location limiter in ghlRequest, 429 pauses the budget. PR #43.

title: Fix review findings on the safety layer
description: From agent review of #43: taint lost on resume (derive from message list); regex evasions (newline, soft hyphen, plain phrasings) and taint any run that read public free text; thrown tool errors bypass screen; keys not screened; test-mode cleanup bypasses limiter; limiter maps never shrink and limit<=0 loops; add resume / error / load_skill / concurrency tests.
notes: Fixed on claude/agent-safety-layer: message-derived taint, public-text taint, regex hardening, key screening, non-JSON GhlError, cleanup uses limiter, limiter validation and sweep, new tests.

title: Agent layer: Mastra harness built and tested on mocks
description: Build and configure the Mastra agent layer (safety, memory, agent controller, agent API) and test it against the fake GHL and AIMock before spending API credits or touching the UI. Chat UI belongs to the site generation engine work.

title: Regenerate GitHub App secrets into Infisical /locus
description: The locus-ghl GitHub App (ID 5265274) was registered without saving its client secret, private key or webhook secret, and GitHub never shows them again. Generate a new client secret and private key at github.com/settings/apps/locus-ghl, set a new webhook secret there, and store all three in Infisical prod /locus. Needed before GitHub install can work (Phase 0 DoD item 17).

title: Turso provisioner: one database per client with database-scoped tokens
description: Replace LocalProvisioner in production. Copy from locus-tenant-template in group locus; mint tokens that can name only that client database; run tenant migrations; offboarding deletes the database. See .claude/rules/tenancy.md.

title: Confirm GHL OAuth against a real agency install
description: Unverified until a real install: authorize URL path (marketplace.leadconnectorhq.com/oauth/chooselocation), install-webhook field names, Ed25519 X-GHL-Signature encoding. Fix packages/connect and the stub to match what GHL actually sends.

description: Follow the vault runbook 1. Projects/Locus/Locus Registrations Runbook.md. Secrets go only into Infisical /locus; record public identifiers in Locus Phase 0. GHL URLs use crm, not ghl (GHL rejects HighLevel in URLs).

description: packages/secrets has MemorySecretStore and LocalSecretStore (refuses production). Add an Infisical store for paths under /locus. The database keeps only secretRef. Decide machine-identity auth for Vercel.

title: Phase 0: finish the foundation
description: Remaining Phase 0 work after PRs #6-#13. Plan: vault 1. Projects/Locus/Locus Phase 0.md. PRD: 2. Areas/Product Manager/PRDs/Locus/Locus.md.

title: Cross-client questions for agencies
description: Run one read-only question across every client the member can access, fanned out in code so no client is dropped, without the model naming a client.

description: EMAIL_MODE=resend, EMAIL_FROM on mail.otakusolutions.io. Verify sign-up verification and invitation emails arrive.

description: The runbook leaves Vercel environment variables out on purpose. Choose between Infisical runtime fetch with a machine identity and Infisical-to-Vercel sync.

title: GitHub App connect flow and webhook
description: App locus-ghl (ID 5265274) is registered with request_oauth_on_install. Build /api/connect/github/callback and /api/webhooks/github; store installations in githubInstallation. The private key lives in Infisical, never in an environment variable.

title: Vercel Integration connect flow
description: /api/connect/vercel/callback: exchange the code, store the token via secretRef in hostConnection. Scopes: projects, deployments, domains read/write; teams and user read.

description: Later in Phase 0. Don't create Stripe products until this is picked up.
